title: test: Check dumpcap with a Big Endian SHB first
description:
Add test variants for MixedEndian dumpcap tests that
have a Big Endian SHB input first, to test the issue
fixed by d52ee96bec639601e9811eef7cb0190fb8270f9c

Have the check_capinfos_info function in the tests also
retrieve the number of interfaces and the list of User
Application options (list in case of multiple SHBs).

Gather information programmatically about the input files
in check_dumpcap_pcapng_sections.

Ping #19965, #15754
